content.title: 'We Know What The End Is': 'Paradise' Has Officially Been Renewed for A Third Season
content.text: It’s official: Paradise has been renewed for a third season by Hulu, ahead of its season two finale on March 30. The renewal comes after fans received a major cliffhanger in season two, episode seven ('The Final Countdown'), which saw Agent Xavier finally reunited with Terri, his wife whom he’d been searching for since leaving the bunker at the end of season one. Terri’s reappearance sets the stage for an exciting season two finale and a host of possible plot lines for the subsequent season — but will season three of Paradise be its last?Here’s everything we know about Paradise season three, as well as the fate of the show for future seasons.What will Paradise season three be about?There’s no official logline for Paradise season three yet, but more details will be released closer to its release date. For now, expect it to build on the logline for season two: 'Xavier (Sterling K. Brown) searches for Teri (Enuka Okuma) out in the world and learns how people have survived the three years since 'The Day'. Back in Paradise, the social fabric frays as the bunker deals with the aftermath of season one, and new secrets are uncovered about the city’s origins.'Who is in the cast of Paradise season three?According to Variety, 'Sterling K. Brown leads the cast alongside series regulars Julianne Nicholson, Sarah Shahi, Nicole Brydon Bloom, Krys Marshall, Enuka Okuma, Aliyah Mastin, Percy Daggs IV and Charlie Evans. James Marsden, Shailene Woodley, Thomas Doherty, and Jon Beavers are recurring guest stars.'When will Paradise season three premiere?There is no premiere date yet for Paradise season three, but season two was released in 2026, a little over one year after season one. Following the same trend, it’s possible the third season of Paradise could arrive sometime in 2027, but we’ll await official confirmation.Will there be future seasons of Paradise after season three?Season three of Paradise will very likely be its last. The show’s executive producer, John Hoberg, told The Hollywood Reporter in February 2026 that it was hard to imagine the show extending to a fourth season.
